source.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Prepare the fixed SOURCE FRAME for an eight-view turntable of the EXACT cognac-tan leather handbag in the reference. Change only the orientation and framing to a straight-on FRONT product photograph. Preserve the pebbled cognac leather, structured satchel silhouette wider at the bottom, rounded upper corners, two short rounded top handles, front flap shape and precise saddle stitching, small brushed-brass rectangular turn-lock with vertical rotating bar, edge paint, and side gusset construction. Do not redesign the product or add branding, charms, tags, pockets or shoulder straps. Camera fixed at modest catalog-photo elevation, whole closed bag and handles visible. Front panel and central turn-lock face squarely toward the camera, left/right symmetry, no large side panel exposed. Bag BODY vertical axis at x=627 of a 1254-square image, centered on the same axis as handles. Full silhouette fits inside approximately x=200..1054 and y=140..1060: leave enough white margin for later rotated views. Put the center of its resting base at x=627 and baseline y=1060. Pure white #FFFFFF seamless floor and backdrop outside localized shadow. Single fixed large softbox above CAMERA LEFT, restrained warm highlights on upper/left leather and brass, darker right surfaces, consistent neutral-warm exposure, soft neutral-gray floor/contact shadow extending SCREEN RIGHT. Preserve fine leather grain and stitching without over-sharpening. No other products, hands, props, text, logos, watermarks, borders or panels. Output ONE photorealistic high-resolution square 1254 by 1254 product photograph, not a collage. This source fixes product identity, camera, scale, ground anchor and lighting for the subsequent independent rotation edits.

execution: Seven independent rotations from the fixed normalized source. No rotated output used to generate another. JPEG format conversion only; display registration recorded separately in framing.json.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE rotation frame of the EXACT cognac pebbled-leather handbag in the reference. This reference is the ONLY product identity, geometry, camera, exposure and scale anchor. Rotate the whole CLOSED bag rigidly around its vertical center axis to the requested angle; keep both short top handles and all attachments in their original positions relative to the bag. Preserve its trapezoidal body wider at the base, rounded upper corners, structured gussets, curved front flap, precise saddle stitching and edge paint, cognac leather grain, and small brushed-brass rectangular turn-lock. The main front flap and brass plate exist ONLY on the FRONT; the rear is a plain continuous cognac leather panel with matching perimeter stitching, no pocket, zipper, label, plaque or second clasp. No shoulder straps, tags, charms, feet added, branding or decorative features. Keep the body rotation axis centered at x=627 in this 1254-square canvas, keep the resting base centered and at the SAME floor baseline as the reference, keep the top of the handles at the SAME height. Maintain the same true object scale and camera elevation; side views naturally become NARROWER, never zoom to fill the square. Whole bag and handles visible with white margins. The single large softbox stays ABOVE CAMERA LEFT: highlights on upper/left surfaces and brass, shadows to the right; warm-neutral balance, realistic leather texture, soft neutral-gray cast/contact floor shadow extending SCREEN RIGHT. Do not mirror or rotate lighting, shadows, camera, or backdrop with the product. Pure white #FFFFFF seamless floor/background beyond the localized shadow. Photorealistic premium catalog photograph, ONE square 1254 by 1254 image. No props, hands, text, logos, watermarks, collage, borders or panels. Requested angle: 45 degrees. FRONT-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER. Show the front flap and clasp on the broad front panel, with the RIGHT-SIDE gusset visible on SCREEN RIGHT. Front panel is foreshortened and lies slightly to SCREEN LEFT within the silhouette. Both top handles retain their same orientation on the front/back panels and are seen in perspective. This is the intermediate view between straight front and the narrow right-side profile.
